content: 14:1-12 In oau naget Qenu qob dibes qomorun
Munon qei wuriqenungarau eng mom sig-sig ebet igoarar. Igo ne Igomurur mi banam ar andab igo eng mom ba gitet wab igoarar. Ne Qenu qob dibes qamarau eng mom qeretutnob igoarar.
Munon ger qob wes-wes end qamara munon qei qob eng me imbigunorei. End Igomurur oau menima wo mi waber igo eng Qenu qas nob qamb igo.
A munon ger Qenu qob dibes wurinob qamara wuri igub oabig ne nonoguret qomon uber qas ebet igour.
Munon ger wonou qob wes end qamb igo eng wonomi nonogursi igo. Ne Qenu qob dibes qamb igo eng munon yamangar wurinonogursi igo.

Ye qenungoum eng an gugum qob wes-wes end qamarar. Ego an gugum Igomurur an oau menima Qenu qob gor gugum dibes qomorunon eng sig-sig mom qenungoum. Munon ger Qenu qob dibes qamb igo eng munon qob wes end qamb igo eng wotanami igo. Munon qob wes end qamara gab eng bo munon ger biiges munon gugum qob igub igour end qamara gugum igub nonoguretorunor.

End ne ye anit yarab qob wes-wes qei aninob qemerine an me imbigunanei. Eng, mai, Qenu qob yiimbig igo eng me aninob qamb qiyo me animbig qiyo, Qenu qob me dibes qamb qiyo, ebein eng an maigas imbiguboumon?
Eng gas ende, sibemi qiyo ain mer gusit qiyo birouri mindat ende me oboun eng mai wurinou maigas toau bigari toau uber iguboun?
Ne munon yogurub qamb ain mer musub me gusimari igub maigas imbig mi musub igorubour?
Eng gas ende gari, munon ginam qei wurinou qob munon qei me igub igour end qob wurinob qamarari wuri maigas imbigubour? Me imbigunorei, aninou qob eng ar isi isiba.
Git apand, qob wes-wes ag et igo. Ego qob eng qomour ger ar me igo, qob mi git nob qas igo.
End ne munon ger wonou qobt qamara ye me iginei. Igub ne ye imbigibam, munon eng wonou ginam ger.
An gor ende sig, Igomurur mi ar banam andab igo eng aninou mom gitet wab igorunon eng Qenu wonou munon yurau wurimbanamsi igo eng wuriqubeimboumon.
14:13-25 Qob wes-wes qamarau werei end Pol qamarei
Munon ger wonou qob wes end qamb gab eng bo Qenu qebi qamb ne qob qemeriner eng qanam dibes qamara munon gugum igunor.

Ye qob wes end Qenut qebi qemerin eng git apand Igomurur ye oau menima Qenut qebi qemeribam. Ego qob qemerin eng qanam musub me imbig ne ar qabarit qas Qenu nob qemeribam. Yonou misir me nonogureterinerei.

End ne ye mai ebeibam? Qen qei Igomurur ye oau menima qob wes-wes end Qenut qebi qamb qiyo uru wab ende ebet igorin. Ne gor qen qei ye qob igub ne qanam musub imbig-imbig Qenut qebi qamb qiyo uru wab ende ebet igorin.
An Igomurur oau menima qob wes end qamb Qenut uber qamb igamari munon ar ger igub wo maigas imbig, qob eng apand qemeriba? Eng wo me imbiginerei, qob toau qas igiba, qob qanam sir me imbiginerei.
Git apand Qenut uber qomorun eng munon eng me imbiginer end uber ue.
Ye qob wes qamarau eng tari igoum ye an antanami igoum end Qenut mismisir igoum.
Ego sios qiumunimau qob 5-ende dibes qemerine munon yamangar musub igub imbigunor. A qob wes end qemerib qamb eng qob 10,000-ende qemerine munon me imbigunor eng song wegibam.
Io, an wau qamaaman misir gas ende me igar. Qomon boru eng an ende igorunon eng uber. Qomon uber eng an munon baraitari misir qo qomon end igoarar.

End qob ete gumatemirei igo: ‘Yonou munon yurau e igamari munon ginam qei wurinou qob wes end wurinob qemeribam. Munon yogurisau wurinob qemerine tumbig yonou munon yurau wurinob qomorubour. Ende abari wuri ye qob me igisunorei.’ Munon Aib ende qamarei.

Qob eng ende igo end ne Sios yurau qiumuni qei qob mindiram goten wes end qamb igamari munon Yisast me oabig igour eng yarab ibag Qenu wurimaribigor eng imbigar qamb. Munon Yisast mom oabig igour eng wuri ue. A, qob qanam dibes qamb igamari munon Yisast mom oabig igour eng yarab ibag Qenu wurimaribigor eng imbigar qamb. Yisast me oabig igour eng wuri ue.
An ende abari sios munon yurau qiumuni igamari an der qob wes-wes end qamarari ne munon qei me imbig ne gor me oabig eng mor diab ete aninob qomorubour: “qanganget at igoumon?”
Ende qomorunor ego an Qenu qob apand dibes wurinob qamb igamari munon ger me imbig qiyo me oabig mor dieriner eng an qob eng oau menima ne oabigiba.
Wonou qob gugum misirt igoriner eng dibenara gab gamaur wat bugab Qenut mismisiriba. Ende at aninob qemeriba: “apand Qenu anoopuri ten igo,” ende qemeriba.
14:26-40 Sios yurau musub igamau eng

Io, ye qob quraum eng an imbigoumon? An gugum qiumuni sarau wes-wes abar. Ger uru weriner, ger qob imbig qemeriner, ne ger Qenu wonou uyes qob imbiga eng dibes qemeriner. Ne ger munon qob wes-wes end qamara ger qob eng biiges qemeriner. An gugum ende abari sios munon gugum nonoguretorubour.
Munon qei qob wes-wes end qomorub eng mai, ombur qiyo ombur gari eng mom. Ger qamb waga ne bo ger qemeriner. Ende abari ne bo qei der qob eng biiges qamarari imbigunor.
Ne munon ger qob eng biiges qemeriner eng ue gab eng me qemeriner. Wonou gari Qenu nob qemeriner eng uber.
Munon ombur qiyo ombur gari ende Qenu qob qanam dibes qomorub eng qamarari qei ar igo qob eng qereimunor.
Ne munon ger der qob qamb igama ne munon ger bugab igama Qenu qob ger imbiga qemeriba gab eng munon naget igo qob qamb igoriner eng wo bo weginer.
Werei end ne an gari-gari qob qeemben qamarari munon gugum imbig nonoguretorubour.
Munon Qenu qob dibes qamb igour eng wurinou imbig igour.
Qenu wo me inqangangsi igo. Wo inseara qibanamsi igoun.
Sios qiumuni gab eng yamangar wuri qob ger me qomorunor, qi igorunor. Yuda wurinou qomon igo gas ende yamangar wuri gigit me igorunor. Sios gugum wurinou qomon ende igo.
Wuri qob qanam ger me imbig eng mor end igo wurinou umami qebi gunor. Qiumunimau end isub yamangar wuri qib qomorunor eng wuri qomon biisitoubour.
Mai, Qenu qob an gari gigit imbig ne munon qei wurinob qamamanei qiyo? A an gari aninob qamarari imbigumanei qiyo?

An munon ger wonou ete misir igub eng: “Ye Qenu qob dibes qamarau eng qoyam imbi-imbi qamb qiyo, a Igomurur ye gari yoopuri igama sarau uber oboum,” ende qamb misir iginer eng ete nob qemerine igar: ye qob e gumaum eng Munon Aib wonou qomon eng qamb gumaum.
Munon ger ende misir igub ye qob omboarirminer eng munon eng aninob qamara me igatatar.
Io, end ne an Qenu qob dibes qamarau end an me qer urimar. Ne gor munon qei qob wes-wes end qob qomorubari gab an me wurigitatarar.
End ne an Sios munon yurau end sarau booub qamb eng qomon uber uninim toat abar.
